coverage.crc_basis: Complete 20/24-byte message basis and full32-bit seed basis: 416 checks, with independent bitwise and standard CRC oracles.
coverage.crc_random: 10240 arbitrary raw32 seeds per segment length over all32 byte alignments.
coverage.table: All2048 extra entries checked using an independent normal IEEE generator plus reflected bitwise zero-byte recurrence.
coverage.guard: Typed20/24 bytes at both real PROT_NONE page edges, using arbitrary raw seeds.
coverage.alias: Destination state overlaps each input word position; expected result is computed by the independent bitwise oracle before the state write.
coverage.format: Original frozen v1/v2 golden plus full64 sequence/generation extremes/random values, payload lengths0..4096 and segmented delivery; only legal24-byte reference inputs.

unqualified: Actual hot row hashes, table placement/duplication, frame/call lowering, rodata and performance remain for the parent actual gate.
8192 is the logical additional table budget, not a claim about emitted binary size or speed.
